_comment: Registry of AI tools the knowledge kit installs into. Edit INSTRUCTIONS.md for behavior; edit this file to add/remove tools, then re-run install.py. To add a tool: copy an entry, set name/target/scope. scope=global installs once per machine; scope=project generates a per-repo file (managed between KNOWLEDGE-KIT markers, so it never clobbers a project's own rules).
